retrieval_skill.name: reliable_trend_horizon_check
retrieval_skill.description: Identify a measurement-supported latent trend, extrapolate its direction cautiously, and compare the implied stopping or transition point with the forecast horizon.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When a recent time series exhibits a stable directional trend and the task requires short-horizon continuation or stopping behavior.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search the specified observation window for evidence about trend continuity, measurement reliability, and the time implied for the process to reach a natural boundary; reject unsupported quotations and impact claims lacking verified citations.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a trend claim only when reliable observations within the required temporal window support it, preserve exact-quote and provenance requirements, and independently verify whether the implied boundary occurs inside or beyond the forecast horizon.
